mapper.select: SELECT /*+ALL_ROWS*/ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.TABLE_NAME) AS LISTNUM, A.TABLE_NAME AS TBL_NAME, A.COMMENTS AS TBL_DESC, TO_CHAR(B.NUM_ROWS) AS ROW_CNT, ROUND(SUM((B.NUM_ROWS - C.NUM_NULLS)) / DECODE((COUNT(C.COLUMN_NAME) * B.NUM_ROWS), 0, 1, (COUNT(C.COLUMN_NAME) * B.NUM_ROWS)), 3) * 100 ROW_PER FROM ALL_TAB_COMMENTS A, ALL_TABLES B, ALL_TAB_COL_STATISTICS C WHERE 1=1 AND A.OWNER = B.OWNER AND A.OWNER = C.OWNER AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME AND A.TABLE_NAME = C.TABLE_NAME AND A.OWNER = 'MPPS' AND A.TABLE_TYPE = 'TABLE' GROUP BY A.TABLE_NAME, COMMENTS, B.NUM_ROWS ORDER BY A.TABLE_NAME
SELECT count(*) FROM ALL_TABLES WHERE 1=1 AND OWNER = 'MPPS'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.COLUMN_ID) AS LISTNUM, A.TABLE_NAME, A.COLUMN_NAME AS COL_NAME, B.COMMENTS AS COL_COMMENT, A.DATA_TYPE, A.DATA_LENGTH AS COL_LEN, A.COLUMN_ID AS COL_ID, A.NULLABLE AS NULL_YN, (D.NUM_ROWS - C.NUM_NULLS) AS NOTNULL_CNT, D.NUM_ROWS AS ROW_CNT, DECODE(D.NUM_ROWS, 0, 0, ROUND((D.NUM_ROWS - C.NUM_NULLS) / D.NUM_ROWS, 3) * 100) CNT_PER FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS A, ALL_COL_COMMENTS B, ALL_TAB_COL_STATISTICS C, ALL_TABLES D WHERE 1=1 AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME AND A.TABLE_NAME = C.TABLE_NAME AND B.TABLE_NAME = C.TABLE_NAME AND A.TABLE_NAME = D.TABLE_NAME AND A.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME AND B.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME AND A.OWNER = 'MPPS' AND B.TABLE_NAME = #{TABLE_NAME}
ORDER BY A.COLUMN_ID

SELECT A.COLUMN_NAME AS COL_NAME, A.COLUMN_NAME||DECODE(B.COMMENTS, NULL, '', CHR(13)||CHR(10)||'('||B.COMMENTS||')') AS COL_DESC FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS A, ALL_COL_COMMENTS B WHERE 1=1 AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME AND A.COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME AND A.OWNER = 'MPPS' AND B.TABLE_NAME = #{TABLE_NAME}

SELECT A.COLUMN_NAME||DECODE(B.COMMENTS, NULL, '', CHR(13)||CHR(10)||'('||B.COMMENTS||')') AS COL_DESC FROM ALL_TAB_COLUMNS A, ALL_COL_COMMENTS B WHERE 1=1 AND A.TABLE_NAME = B.TABLE_NAME AND A.COLUMN_NAME = B.COLUMN_NAME AND A.OWNER = 'MPPS' AND B.TABLE_NAME = #{TABLE_NAME}
